release_notes:
FocusDefend v1.8.2 Production Release — Unbypassable Restriction Shield & AI Wellbeing:
• High-Priority Instant Blocking: Synchronous full-screen WindowManager overlay (#F5090E17 dark backdrop) immediately shields restricted apps in normal mode and study mode with zero delay.
• Auto-Perimeter Detection: Expanded DefaultAppsInitializer automatically scans device launcher apps to classify and restrict Social Media, Streaming, and Gaming apps without requiring manual setup.
• YouTube Interception Fix: Fixed normal-mode YouTube restriction bypass logic so that distracting entertainment is guarded while educational study sessions remain protected.
• Strict Session Verification: Room DAO query hardened to strictly check remainingTimeMs > 0, preventing expired sessions from granting app access.
• Thread-Safe UI Dispatch: Main Looper enforcement across overlay lifecycle methods guarantees seamless screen updates without worker-thread dropping.
